newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Thai Cosmo to enter Philippine petrol market.
newsitem.headline: Thai Cosmo to enter Philippine petrol market.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd of Thailand is entering the Philippine petroleum market as a distributor of oil products, the presidential palace said on Tuesday.

Cosmo, through its subsidiary Cosmo Oil (Philippines) Inc, will initially distribute petroleum, bunker fuel, and lubricants in the local market before putting up gasoline stations throughout the country.
Cosmo Oil is an unlisted Thai firm that is not connected to Japan's Cosmo Oil Co Ltd, an official at the presidential palace said.

The company did not disclose how much it will invest in the country. Cosmo is one of the foreign oil companies which have expressed interest in investing in oil-related ventures after the government liberalised the industry.
The Philippine venture will be the first overseas subsidiary of Cosmo Oil. - Manila newsroom 63 2 841 8938 Fax 817 6267
